verdict.rationale: Adyen documents two onboarding paths: API-only onboarding through the Legal Entity Management API, and hosted onboarding where Adyen runs the flow and UI. Adyen also verifies sellers before payouts. That covers the API and hosted-flow core of the story, but the pack says nothing about embeddable onboarding components, bank account linking, or terms acceptance. missing for 10: evidence of embeddable onboarding components, bank account linking during onboarding, terms-of-service acceptance flow, explicit KYB/KYC detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
